description: This file defines utility functions for stream copying and handling in Apache Spark, including methods for copying streams with optional NIO transfer, converting InputStream to String, and reading fully into byte arrays.

classes.name: SparkStreamUtils
classes.description: A trait providing utility methods for stream copying, conversion, and reading in Spark.

methods.name: copyStream
methods.description: Copies data from an InputStream to an OutputStream, optionally using NIO transfer if transferToEnabled is true.

methods.name: copyFileStreamNIO
methods.description: Performs a file stream copy using NIO transferTo method, ensuring correct position and handling kernel bugs.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts an InputStream to a String.

methods.name: readFully
methods.description: Reads bytes fully into an array from an InputStream.
